_schema.Note: English (US) templates. Keep keys identical to zh_CN.json.

welcome: You take your first step into the heart of the Shanhai continent. Beyond the Central Mountains and the four ranges, the Great Wilderness awaits... Legend says four elder titans sleep in the Wilderness, each keeping one Heavenly Scroll. Gather all four, prepare the offerings, and study them to ascend.
monster_dies: The {name} crashes down, a corpse on the floor.
player_dies: Your strength fails... your trek through Shanhai ends here.
victory_title: ~ A S C E N S I O N ~
victory_flavor: Four scrolls as one; all Shanhai surveyed. The Way is yours - nothing binds you here now.
victory_hint: You have ascended — Enter: new cycle, Esc: quit.
smoke_used: You invoke the smoke talisman; for {turns} turns, beasts lose your trail.
smoke_fade: The smoke thins away; you stand exposed once more.
knockback_used: The charm bursts like a landslide; the {target} is hurled back!
knockback_wall: The {target} slams into the wall, seeing stars!
tianshu_volume_got: {item}, writ in elder glyphs, settles into your pack. Scrolls: {got}/{total}.
tianshu_all_got: All four Heavenly Scrolls gathered! Prepare 5 Elite Essence, 4 Demon Cores and 3 Dragon Scales, then study any scroll in your pack to ascend.
tianshu_missing: The scrolls are incomplete; still missing: {missing}.
tianshu_mat_missing: All four scrolls in hand, but offerings fall short; still missing: {missing}.
ascend_start: The four scrolls thunder into one; the map of mountains and seas unfolds before your eyes—
ascend_done: Light pours through you - ascension in broad daylight! You transcend Shanhai; only your legend remains.
level_up: Realm deepens! Level {level}. HP+8, Qi+4, Spirit+2, PWR+1, DEF+1, skill point+1.
no_item_here: There is nothing here to take.
heal_used: You eat the lingzhi and recover {amount} HP.
heal_full: You are already at full health.
lightning_used: The talisman cracks — a bolt of thunder strikes {target} for {damage} damage.
lightning_no_target: No enemy in sight for the thunder to strike.
inventory_title: Pack (Tab page · letters use/equip · E cursor · Esc)
not_on_stairs: There is no trail onward here.
ascend: You take the trail back to {region} — {mountain}.
not_on_up_stairs: There is no trail back here.
not_learned: You have not learned this art.
hp_low: Not enough HP to cast this.

cast_aoe: You cast {skill}; the surge washes over {count} enemies.
buff_fade: A borrowed strength quietly leaves you.
summon_fade: {name}'s pact runs out; it fades into light.

heal_mp_used: You take the breath powder and recover {amount} qi.
examine_title: Examine (Tab: next · click: pick · Esc: close)
descend_plain: You descend; the way grows darker.
realm_exit: You emerge back into the open wilds.
realm_sealed: This realm is sealed; the gate stands shut.
realm_boss_slain: {boss} collapses! The realm's power disperses and its gate is sealed forever.
travel_stop_enemy: You spot movement ahead and halt.
travel_stop_gate: A realm gate stands before you; you stop.
travel_stop_blocked: Your path is blocked; travel ends.
travel_stop_region: You enter unfamiliar lands and pause.
save_ok: Your journey is inscribed on the map scroll.
save_loaded: You unroll the map scroll and resume your journey.

buff_item_defense: Gang qi shields you: defense +{amount} for {turns} turns.

realm_exit_hint: To return to the wilds, step onto the cyan path (to the {bearing}, the glowing steps you arrived on).
realm_enter_hint: To return to the wilds: go back to the cyan path you arrived on and press <.
